input.command:
while true; do
  ssh autodl-5090 "tmux has-session -t indep_seed 2>/dev/null" || { echo "PIPELINE_ENDED: tmux session gone"; break; }
  
  pythia_lines=$(ssh autodl-5090 "wc -l < /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/independent_seed/pythia-2.8b-indepA/generations_shard0.jsonl 2>/dev/null" || echo "0")
  olmo_lines=$(ssh autodl-5090 "wc -l < /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/independent_seed/olmo-2-1b-indepB/generations_shard0.jsonl 2>/dev/null" || echo "0")
  
  results=$(ssh autodl-5090 "cat /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/independent_seed_results.json 2>/dev/null" || echo "")
  if [ -n "$results" ]; then
    echo "EVALUATION_COMPLETE: $results"
    break
  fi
  
  pythia_seeds=$((pythia_lines / 5))
  olmo_seeds=$((olmo_lines / 5))
  
  echo "PROGRESS: Pythia=${pythia_seeds}/500, OLMo=${olmo_seeds}/500"
  
  sleep 300
done
